title: Three Figures with Book
description: A man sits in the center holding an open book titled STASIS while yellow liquid pours from his head down his chest. Two yellow women with long hair touch him, one on each side, in a dark ruined room with papers and tools scattered on the floor.
prompt: A man sits in the center of a dark ruined room holding an open book titled STASIS as yellow liquid pours from cuts on his head down his chest and pools around him. Two women with long yellow hair stand on each side touching his shoulders, one with a cape and the other with a braid and markings on her back, papers and tools lie scattered on the floor around them in a damaged interior space with peeling walls.
